messages:
zane_marketing: Quick sync for tomorrow's release — need final marketing-friendly changelog, prod docs permalink, benchmark vignette, webinar RSVP copy, and HubSpot routing/webhook. Can we lock these by EOD?
elaine_pm: scope locked to batching + streaming tweaks only. i'll post two short bullets in a sec.
kai_eng: canary set for 10:00 PT, 12m canary + 30m observability. marketing please hold public posts until 10:45 PT.
mina_docs: building docs bundle now (migration note + API diff + tiny example). staging: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1-preview
otto_ops: i'll wire the HubSpot webhook after we get a success event. need tag name from marketing. will include sample payload on success.
rachel_sdr: routing: enterprise -> SDR-Priority, trials -> nurture. also want demo signups posted to #sales-inbound. need the HubSpot tag.
zane_marketing: tag: `fall-unify-2-1`. draft changelog (marketing friendly):
- ~15% typical per-token cost reduction on embedding-heavy flows
- improved streaming reliability for long conversations (fewer reconnects)
impact sentence for email: "Lower unit costs plus steadier streaming help teams scale inference with more predictable latency."
kai_eng: 15% is for our common embedding profile. please add "typical workloads" qualifier to avoid overclaiming.
mina_docs: examples + short curl demo will be in the confirmation email: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"demo"}'`
otto_ops: webhook endpoint ready: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/fall-unify-2-1 (will enable after deploy-bot posts success).
deploy-bot: Canary started at 10:00 PT. Posting events to #release-war-room.
zane_marketing: marketing request: wait 30m after canary success before social + email to watch telemetry. target public at 10:45 PT.
kai_eng: agreed. monitoring rule: if p99 > baseline +20% or error rate >3x, we pause and roll back. we'll notify this thread. :warning:
rachel_sdr: once webhook is live, i'll test HubSpot mapping and ensure demo signups create property `lead_source:fall-unify-2-1`.
mina_docs: prod docs link will be posted here once tyler flips prod. slides + benchmark gist uploading to drive now.
deploy-bot: Canary success at 10:11 PT. Observability hold until 10:41 PT. Event payload sample: `{ "event":"release", "version":"2.1", "status":"canary-success" }`
otto_ops: enabling webhook now and running a quick test. sample payload posted to #release-war-room.
rachel_sdr: tested webhook + HubSpot workflow; routing green. demo signups post to #sales-inbound.
zane_marketing: docs permalink? we need that for the registration confirmation and press pack.
mina_docs: prod docs permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — contains migration note, API diff, and example snippets. benchmark vignette (anonymized): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-benchmarks
zane_marketing: perfect. i'll draft the social + email copy and drop for a 10-min PR. social plan: short blog + benchmark vignette + webinar CTA.
kai_eng: telemetry looks stable during hold. stand by 10 more mins.
zane_marketing: scheduling public for 10:45 PT. will wait in-thread for any rollback signals. thanks team! :rocket:
